questions: What is flavor?

If the mass is zero, is there nothing there?

If one generation is gone, does the next take its place?

If the spin reverses, does it start turning the other way?
What is charge?
If the charge runs out, does it stop working?

If the width is narrow, can it fit through a smaller gap?

If the cross section gets bigger, does it take up more space?

After annihilation, is absolutely nothing left?
What is mixing?
After mixing, can it become what it was before?

When confinement ends, can what was inside come out by itself?

If the vacuum is empty, can anything happen in it?

Once you cross a threshold, does the new thing have to appear?
